title: Improving Infant Nutrition in Southern Ethiopia
brief_summary: This cluster randomized controlled trial will test the effect of the promotion of vitamin A-rich orange flesh sweet potato (OFSP) production and nutrition education on vitamin A and energy intake, including any added value of the Healthy Baby Toolkit.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

1. Participation in a Healthy Living Club (only a criteria for those in partial or full intervention arms)
2. Infant aged birth to 5 months
3. Primary caregiver and head of household (if different from primary caregiver) available and provides consent for survey

Exclusion Criteria:

1\. Serious health problem (for example, HIV/AIDS or congenital defect)
